results.title: Senate seeks renegotiation of Nigeria-China BASA to allow direct flights into China - Tribune Online
results.snippet:
In a resolution passed in Abuja on Tuesday, the Senate called on the Federal Government to renegotiate the BASA to allow Nigerian airlines to operate direct flights to China.

It also urged the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs to initiate diplomatic talks with China on business visa facilitation for Nigerian traders and reciprocal slot allocations at Chinese airports.
